notes.title: Indie Pearls from Rhineland-Palatinate
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31322626/d9ff2022833866ce90425a1a645ee99ab13e6871.jpg

Indie Pearls from Rhineland-Palatinate

From the country where the printing press was invented, Karl Marx saw the light of day and probably the best Riesling wine is grown now comes an incomparable indie game bundle: 

The Indie Pearls from RLP. We are local indie studios and have teamed up to bring you a good choice of regional products for the first time as a joint Rhineland-Palatinate bundle. Complete your collection and get these indie gems now for -20% off!

In this bundle, you'll find great games from developer studios from all over Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. Included are games by the studios 
Grimbart Tales, Binary Impact, Rhine Games, netmin games, Gentlymad, Sleeping Forest Interactive and Andarion Games GmbH.

Here you will find games for every taste and every age group. Whether you are a sports lover, a management guru, a VR fan or a casual gamer - discover a new gem in your collection!

Now available
